title: The b-containment-inverted defect, hidden inside a realistic multi-hunk commit
changeCommitMessage: paths: reject escaping joins and normalise roots once
claim: joinUnderRoot in src/paths.mjs now normalizes the joined path and throws if a relative input would resolve past the root, returning the normalized path otherwise. The same commit adds a shared normalizeRoot helper so every containment helper tolerates a trailing separator on the root, and updates the README table. test/paths.test.mjs covers the rejection and the trailing-separator handling, and the suite passes.

defect.summary: isUnderRoot, changed by the same commit as part of the normalizeRoot routing but absent from the claim, now returns `!path.startsWith(root)`: the containment test is inverted, so it reports contained paths as outside and outside paths as contained.
